weakness: Integrator remote access is always on, undocumented, unapproved per session, shared, and without MFA
source: P07 (AC-17 objectives); P01 R-002; P03 PR.AA-03
remediation_plan: Remove the always-on tool; vendor access only through a jump host with named accounts, MFA, per-session approval by the OCC shift lead, and session recording
milestones: 2026-10-15 jump host built; 2026-11-15 integrator cut over; 2026-11-30 old tool removed

weakness: Broad IT/OT rules; remote desktop from IT to HMIs; dual-homed engineering workstation; cloud VPN allows return traffic; internet-exposed modems
source: P07 (SC-7 objectives); P01 R-001; P04 finding 1
remediation_plan: OT DMZ with the historian replica feed as the only crossing; rule clean-up; retire the dual-homed workstation; one-way cloud push; modems on the private network
milestones: 2026-09-30 modems moved (see POAM-013); 2026-11-30 DMZ design approved; 2027-01-31 cutover

weakness: SCADA backups in the same room and domain; controller programs not backed up; cloud backups in the production account and region; documentation not backed up
source: P07 (CP-9 objectives); P01 R-003; P04 finding 2
remediation_plan: Weekly offline copy of SCADA images and controller programs in a safe at the South Florida field office; separate backup account with immutable retention in a second region; copy of SCADA documentation
milestones: 2026-10-15 offline copies started; 2026-11-30 cloud backup account migrated

weakness: No contingency plan or backup testing; no SCADA restore ever attempted
remediation_plan: Quarterly restore test of a SCADA server image to a spare server, with hash checks of controller programs; annual contingency tabletop
milestones: 2026-10-30 first restore test; 2027-03-31 first contingency tabletop

weakness: Shared HMI operator login and shared integrator account
remediation_plan: Named integrator accounts through POAM-001; named HMI accounts if the SCADA software supports fast user switching after the OS upgrade, otherwise a documented compensating control (badge-controlled OCC, shift sign-in log, monthly event review) per the SP 800-82 Rev. 3 OT overlay
milestones: 2026-11-30 integrator named accounts; 2027-03-31 HMI decision implemented

weakness: No OT inventory of controllers, drives, meters, modems, and radios
source: P07 (CM-8 objectives); P01 R-012; P03 ID.AM-01
remediation_plan: Build the OT inventory (model, firmware, address, location, criticality) from a site survey and the passive OT monitoring sensor; review quarterly
milestones: 2026-12-15 site survey complete; 2027-01-31 inventory reconciled with sensor data

weakness: No change control for controller logic or SCADA configuration; conflicting program versions found
remediation_plan: OT change procedure: request, peer review, approval by the SCADA and Automation Supervisor, test, record; program repository with version history
milestones: 2026-10-31 procedure approved; 2026-12-31 all programs in the repository

weakness: No monitoring of the SCADA network or remote connections
remediation_plan: Passive OT network monitoring sensor at the OCC, with alerts to the MDR service

weakness: After-hours alerts unwatched; HMI signatures updated by hand; HMI real-time scanning off
remediation_plan: 24x7 managed detection and response for corporate EDR and the cloud VM; weekly HMI signature updates through the scanning kiosk; real-time scanning re-enabled after the OS upgrade

weakness: SCADA servers and HMIs on an unsupported OS; controller firmware not updated; no OT patch time frames
remediation_plan: Upgrade SCADA servers and HMIs to a vendor-qualified supported OS; quarterly OT patch window; firmware updates by criticality

weakness: No SCADA contingency plan; emergency response plan not linked to cyber events
remediation_plan: SCADA contingency plan built from the BIA (P05), linked to the manual-operations procedure and the P08 runbook

weakness: Incident handling capability not in place for OT; no MDR or forensic support; isolation never practiced
remediation_plan: Incident binder at the OCC and field offices; OT-capable forensic firm confirmed on the insurer panel; joint IT and operations tabletop; practice SCADA isolation

weakness: Default passwords on 3 modems (new finding); weak and unchanged SCADA passwords; vendor password in a spreadsheet
remediation_plan: Change all modem passwords and disable internet management; move the 3 modems to the private network; rotate SCADA passwords to 14+ characters; move credentials to the IT password vault

weakness: Late disabling; SCADA accounts outside the account process; no reviews; shared account passwords not changed
remediation_plan: Same-day disable from HR tickets; SCADA accounts added to the termination checklist; quarterly access reviews; remove stale SCADA accounts
milestones: 2026-09-15 stale accounts removed; 2026-10-31 same-day process; 2026-12-31 first quarterly review

weakness: Nonlocal maintenance not approved, monitored, recorded, or strongly authenticated
remediation_plan: Delivered through the jump host in POAM-001; maintenance record kept for each session

weakness: No MFA for SCADA engineer accounts or the integrator
remediation_plan: MFA at the jump host for all remote and privileged SCADA access; physical access control of the OCC as one factor for local engineer access, per the SP 800-82 Rev. 3 OT overlay

weakness: No audit record review
remediation_plan: Central log collection with 1-year retention; weekly identity and firewall review through the MDR service; monthly SCADA event review
milestones: 2026-12-31 MDR reviews start; 2027-03-31 SCADA logs collected

weakness: No training for field staff or Production Controllers; no phishing exercises
remediation_plan: Short mobile training for field staff at safety meetings; OT module for Production Controllers; quarterly phishing exercises

weakness: OT not assessed for vulnerabilities; no remediation time frames
remediation_plan: Monthly advisory matching against the OT inventory; passive vulnerability detection from the OT sensor; remediation time frames by severity

weakness: No security requirements for the integrator, carrier, or other providers; only one provider monitored
source: P07 (SA-9 objectives); P03 GV.SC-05; Fla. Stat. 501.171(6)
remediation_plan: Security schedule in contracts at renewal (named accounts, MFA, incident notice, breach cooperation); annual assurance review of critical providers

weakness: Common cabinet keys and gate combinations not inventoried or changed
remediation_plan: Key and combination log; change gate combinations quarterly and when contractors leave; rekey cabinets as they are replaced
milestones: 2026-10-31 log started; 2027-03-31 combinations on a quarterly cycle
